toolsPreview.name: regexforge_synth
toolsPreview.description: Synthesize a battle-tested regex from labeled examples. Input: optional natural-language description + 20 examples (10 positive, 10 negative, or any mix of ≥4). Output: regex + flags + test matrix proving every example is handled correctly + backtracking-risk analysis. Deterministic; no LLM at serve time.
